verdict.rationale: Highnote's Test environment explicitly claims to replicate full functionality and lets developers simulate real-time transactions including authorizations, refunds, and statements (highnote-docs-11, highnote-docs-26), and the platform documents authorization, capture, refund logic and collaborative/spend-rule based decisioning (highnote-docs-7, highnote-docs-8, highnote-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documentation confirming simulation of clearings, reversals, or declines specifically within the sandbox, nor hands-on/independent corroboration of full lifecycle test coverage. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox documentation of clearings/reversals/decline simulation, and independent verification of sandbox fidelity.
